hero.title: STUDY MBBS IN UZBEKISTAN
hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in Uzbekistan 2026–2027. Fast-growing Central Asian destination with 100% English medium instruction, safe hostels, and modern clinics.

overview: Uzbekistan has emerged as a top choice for Indian students due to its short 3-hour flight from Delhi, affordable cost of living, and high-quality government medical institutes in Tashkent, Samarkand, and Bukhara.

universities.name: Tashkent Medical Academy
universities.desc: The benchmark medical academy in Uzbekistan, with leading hospital branches across Tashkent.

universities.name: Samarkand State Medical Institute
universities.desc: Historic and modern medical institute with over 60 departments and large Indian student body.

universities.name: Bukhara State Medical Institute
universities.desc: Highly regarded for simulation training, clinical pediatrics, and surgical sciences.

universities.name: Andijan State Medical Institute
universities.desc: Leading public academy in Fergana Valley equipped with modern diagnostic facilities.

universities.name: Tashkent Pediatric Medical Institute
universities.desc: Specialized pediatric and general medicine training center with large municipal patient beds.

universities.name: Urgench Branch of Tashkent Medical Academy
universities.desc: Rapidly growing medical branch offering low cost of living and dedicated international hostels.

faq.question: Is MBBS in Uzbekistan valid for Indian students?
faq.answer: Yes, MBBS from NMC & WHO recognized universities in Uzbekistan is fully valid in India upon passing the NExT/FMGE licensing examination.

faq.question: What is the flight time between India and Uzbekistan?
faq.answer: Direct flights from New Delhi to Tashkent take only about 3 hours, making travel very convenient for students and parents.
